tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Warm orange for the primary CTA, active indicators and display type on ink. Never as text on white or canvas-soft (fails contrast).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-active and primary-neutral fills.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the primary button; small labels on ink.

tokens.name: primary-neutral
tokens.usage: Mid orange for secondary illustration fills and tags. Pair with on-primary text.

tokens.name: primary-pale
tokens.usage: Very pale orange tint: warm feature cards, positive badges, the active app-shell row.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, canvas-soft and primary-pale; ground of dark cards, hero-band-dark and the footer.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest neutral for shadows and link hover.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on canvas or canvas-soft (passes 4.5:1).

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Hairline borders (pricing tier) and disabled states. Only 3.4:1 on white: never for small text.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Card surface, nav bar, inputs, modal and toast.

tokens.name: canvas-soft
tokens.usage: Page background, secondary button, table header, row dividers; text colour inside the footer.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success icons and indicators (not text on white).

tokens.name: positive-deep
tokens.usage: Success text, e.g. on the positive badge over primary-pale.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill (pending badge), with warning-content text.

tokens.name: warning-deep
tokens.usage: Warning icons and strokes.

tokens.name: warning-content
tokens.usage: Text on warning fills.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Error icons, destructive outlines.

tokens.name: negative-deep
tokens.usage: Error text on canvas.

tokens.name: negative-darkest
tokens.usage: Pressed state of destructive actions.

tokens.name: negative-bg
tokens.usage: Negative badge ground. The source pairs it with on-primary (ink) text, which fails contrast; use primary-pale text instead.

tokens.name: suit-black
tokens.usage: Spades ♠ and clubs ♣ — always black, also in running text, bids and diagrams (17:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: suit-red
tokens.usage: Hearts ♥ and diamonds ♦ — always red, also in running text (5.6:1 on canvas, 5.0:1 on canvas-soft). Also the vulnerability mark in the compass, with canvas text. Used for nothing else.

tokens.name: table
tokens.usage: The bridge table compass in the centre of a deal diagram. Fill only; the colour carries no meaning.

tokens.name: table-text
tokens.usage: The compass letters N, Ø, S, V on table (7.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Illustration accent only.

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Illustration accent only; the one cool note, used sparingly.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Heavy geometric sans for hero moments. Manrope is served from Google Fonts up to weight 800.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Light statement lines beside heavy display type.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Lead paragraphs introduce a section in one or two calm sentences.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Default reading text for cards and forms.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table headers, helper text. Colour: body.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Icon-button padding, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Button and input vertical padding, nav bar vertical padding, badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Input and toast horizontal padding, table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding, gutters.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a band.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Hero, content-band and footer vertical padding; empty-state padding.

radius.note: Large and soft: cards and buttons both use radius-xl.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: App-shell rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Small cards and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, modals, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons, avatars.
